release_notes:
KLAM 3.7.5 Production Release
Corrected Church 10% Tithe calculation to use only JMD Finance/Giving TITHES for the selected month; USD tithe transactions are excluded.
Corrected Finance Income and Expense Edit Selected functionality so changes to existing transactions save properly without deleting and re-entering them.
Edited transaction amounts now immediately update the Finance registers and financial totals.
KLAM 3.7.5 completed release certification and is the official tested production baseline.
